determinism.hash_seed: Python str hashing is randomized per process (PYTHONHASHSEED); any order derived from set iteration is process-dependent (tested empirically in P16-1)
determinism.p15_cpu_cap: p15_search.Physics.truncated: per-root process_time cap (150 s soft) -> search frontier depends on CPU speed / contention
determinism.p15_prospective_replay: PROSP 053: D re-run plan differed from the benchmark record (P15 0078 section 6); geometry steps equal, travel differed (different witness / online path)
determinism.planner_budget: planner.plan: RRT-Connect stops at max_nodes (deterministic, seed = call_seed(planner2d.seed, key)) or max_wall_seconds=300.0 (safety; flagged wall_clock_cut)

errata.D_no_clearing_set: d_blockers.minimal_sets returns mask [0]*n for NO_CLEARING_SET_WITHIN_POOL; p10c_train_eval.d_items trained proof-grounded ones as an all-zero blocker mask (P13 train 2, validation 1). P16 D masks these records.
errata.P12_kappa: P12 kappa endpoint = abs(mean_seed(kappa_hat) - kappa_true) (corrected in P13); always report the kappa==0 baseline.
errata.P15_0080_lean_inference: 0080 section 5 called B-F3pm / B-F5spm / B-F5qpm 'post-hoc inference masks'. They are separately trained, parameter-matched checkpoints (p13_pipeline._arms: removed factor + widened scene head, PM widths 320/641/448). B-F5spm removes generic AND higher-order coupling (abc8 'B-structured'); it is not generic-only.
errata.P15_prospective_CI: P15 prospective bootstrap CI [0, 0] reflects zero observed discordances; it is not an equivalence interval.

findings.b_catalogue: Frozen B scores the constructor catalogue (root['items'] ORDERED_TEACHER / SCENE_TARGET_ONLY): candidate GENERATION is privileged (mechanism-aware constructor) although labels are not read at inference. P16 B scores scene-only candidates.
findings.d_pool: Frozen D's pool = root['parking'] (constructor lattice objects). P16 D pool = all movable non-target objects (cap) in the scene.
findings.p15_movers: p15_bench.run_arm: movers = objects in ORDERED_TEACHER catalogue sequences (constructor-provided): CATALOGUE_RESTRICTED, not scene-only. Kept as historical replay protocol; P16 uses p16_common.propose_movers (scene-only).
findings.p15_oracle: Guide('oracle') reads the teacher blocker mask (declared non-deployable).
